```{r load data}

# Assign user-defined inputs ----------------------------------------------
# 
# # Since server folders are in a standard structure, use parent folder to get list of all deployments
# dep_names <- list.dirs(tk_choose.dir(caption = "Select parent dir for all deployment folders"), recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
# 
# # select the deployment(s) to summarize
# dep_list <- dlg_list(title = "Select deployments to plot", choices = dep_names, multiple = TRUE)$res |>
#   str_sub(start = 16)


# Manually list deployment names
dep_list <- as.list(c("PARKSAUSTRALIA_CGMP_201807_CG", "PARKSAUSTRALIA_CGMP_201812_CG", "PARKSAUSTRALIA_CGMP_201904_CG",
              "PARKSAUSTRALIA_DAMPIER_202009_DNE", 
              "PARKSAUSTRALIA_MURAT_202002_MRE",
              "PARKSAUSTRALIA_NINGALOO_201909_NGN",
              "PARKSAUSTRALIA_SIMP_201808_WP", "PARKSAUSTRALIA_SIMP_201812_WP", "PARKSAUSTRALIA_SIMP_201906_WP", 
              "PARKSAUSTRALIA_SWC_202201_SWS")|>
  str_sub(start = 16))

# set deployment names
dep_info <- dep_list |>
  set_names(dep_list)


# Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------

# For each deployment in the list, load in UTC hourly presence sheet formatted for HMD join
hp_og <- dep_info |>
  map(~read_csv(choose.files(caption = paste0({.}, " Hourly Presence sheet .csv"))))|>
  # use imap() to get info based on index of each iteration
  # in this case, we want the name of the list element, designated as ".y"
  imap(~mutate(., Dep_ID = .y))


dir_weather <- tk_choose.dir(caption = "Select folder with weather tables (csv)")
weather_og <- dir_weather |>
    # list all files with .txt extension
    list.files(pattern = ".csv") |>
    map_chr(~paste0(dir_weather,"\\",  .)) |>
    # use map to iterate read.delim() function over each file in the directory
    map(~read_csv(.)) 


# load in hourly shrimp presence based on 10kHz TOL band
tol_shrimp <- read_csv("data/All_sites_tables/TOL10khz_shrimp.csv") 

```


```{r reshape and merge hp data}

# making new_cols placeholders to add into original df if they don't exist
new_cols <- c("bal_pres" = 0 , "hbw_pres" = 0 , "fish_c_pres" = 0, 
              "dol_pres" = 0 , "mnk_pres" = 0, 
              "spwh_pres" = 0, "ves_pres" = 0)
hp_allcols <- hp_og |>
  # add columns if they don't exist
  map(~add_column(., !!!new_cols[!names(new_cols) %in% names(.)])
  ) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  left_join(tol_shrimp, by = c("Dep_ID","UTC"))

```

```{r reshape and merge weather}

weather_data <- weather_og |>
  bind_rows() |>
  rename(Dep_ID = "Dep") |>
  # replace missing values coded as -9999 with NA
  mutate(across(-c(UTC, Dep_ID, month_name, tide_station), ~ifelse(. < 0, NA, .)))

hp_env <- hp_allcols |>
  left_join(weather_data, by = c("Dep_ID","UTC"))

```

```{r monthly presence}

hp_month_prop <- hp_env |>
  mutate(month_UTC = month(UTC),
         date_UTC = date(UTC),
         # replace all NA's with 0's in presence cols
         across(ends_with("_pres"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
         # code presence absence as 1/0
         across(ends_with("_pres"), ~if_else(. > 0, 1, 0))) |>
  # group to month level
  group_by(Dep_ID, month_UTC) |>
  summarise(n_days = n_distinct(date_UTC),
            n_hours = n(),
            # caculate total counts per source by month
            bal_count = sum(bal_pres),
            hbw_count = sum(hbw_pres), 
            fish_c_count = sum(fish_c_pres),
            dol_count = sum(dol_pres),
            ves_count = sum(ves_pres),
            mnk_count = sum(mnk_pres),
            spwh_count = sum(spwh_pres),
            shr_count = sum(shr_pres),
            # calculate prop hours present per source per month
            bal_pres = sum(bal_pres)/n_hours,
            hbw_pres = sum(hbw_pres)/n_hours, 
            fish_c_pres = sum(fish_c_pres)/n_hours,
            dol_pres = sum(dol_pres)/n_hours,
            ves_pres = sum(ves_pres)/n_hours,
            mnk_pres = sum(mnk_pres)/n_hours,
            spwh_pres = sum(spwh_pres)/n_hours,
            shr_pres = sum(shr_pres)/n_hours,
            tidal_mag_m = max(height_m, na.rm = TRUE) - min(height_m, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_water_temp_C = mean(water_temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_wind_m_sec = mean(wind_m_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_wind_km_h = mean(wind_km_h, na.rm = TRUE),
            rain_month_avg_mm = mean(rain_month_avg_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
            wind_am_month_avg_kmh = mean(wind_am_month_avg_kmh, na.rm = TRUE),
            wind_pm_month_avg_kmh = mean(wind_pm_month_avg_kmh, na.rm = TRUE)
            
    ) |>
  filter(n_days >= 0.5*days_in_month(month_UTC)) # only keep months with 15+ days

```


```{r light regime by month and light regime}



hp_allcols_light <- hp_env |>
  # add columns for grouping
  mutate(month_UTC = month(UTC),
         date_UTC = date(UTC),
         # replace all NA's with 0's in presence cols
         across(ends_with("_pres"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
         # code presence absence as 1/0
         across(ends_with("_pres"), ~if_else(. > 0, 1, 0))) |>
  
  # get light regime labels
  # get sun elevation by lat/lon
  
  # add in lat/lon by site
  mutate(
    Lat_DD = case_when(
      grepl("_CG",Dep_ID) ~ -31.681,
      grepl("_DNE",Dep_ID) ~ -20.329,
      grepl("_MRE",Dep_ID) ~ -32.584,
      grepl("_NGN",Dep_ID) ~ -22.705,
      grepl("_WP",Dep_ID) ~ -29.698,
      grepl("_SWS",Dep_ID) ~ -33.675,
      grepl("_TRW",Dep_ID) ~ -31.711
    ),
    Lon_DD = case_when(
      grepl("_CG",Dep_ID) ~ 152.91,
      grepl("_DNE",Dep_ID) ~ 117.09,
      grepl("_MRE",Dep_ID) ~ 132.63,
      grepl("_NGN",Dep_ID) ~ 113.55,
      grepl("_WP",Dep_ID) ~ 153.40,
      grepl("_SWS",Dep_ID) ~ 114.58,
      grepl("_TRW",Dep_ID) ~ 115.58
    )
  ) |>
  
  rowwise() |> 
  # assign categories based on sun elev
  mutate(sun_elev_rad = suncalc::getSunlightPosition(UTC, 
                                                     Lat_DD,
                                                     Lon_DD,
                                                     keep = "altitude")$altitude,
         sun_elev_deg = (sun_elev_rad*180)/(pi),
         light_reg = case_when(
           # if sun elev is positive, daytime
           sun_elev_deg > 0 ~ "day",
           # if sun elevation is less than -12, nighttime
           sun_elev_deg < -12 ~ "night",
           # if between 0 and -12, "twilight"
           sun_elev_deg <= 0 & sun_elev_deg >= -12 ~ "twilight"
         )
  ) 
  
hp_monthlight_prop <- hp_allcols_light |>
  # group by month + light regime 
  group_by(Dep_ID, month_UTC, light_reg) |>
  summarise(n_days = n_distinct(date_UTC),
            n_hours = n(),
            # caculate total counts per source
            bal_count = sum(bal_pres),
            hbw_count = sum(hbw_pres), 
            fish_c_count = sum(fish_c_pres),
            dol_count = sum(dol_pres),
            ves_count = sum(ves_pres),
            mnk_count = sum(mnk_pres),
            spwh_count = sum(spwh_pres),
            shr_count = sum(shr_pres),
            # calculate prop hours present per source
            bal_pres = sum(bal_pres)/n_hours,
            hbw_pres = sum(hbw_pres)/n_hours, 
            fish_c_pres = sum(fish_c_pres)/n_hours,
            dol_pres = sum(dol_pres)/n_hours,
            ves_pres = sum(ves_pres)/n_hours,
            mnk_pres = sum(mnk_pres)/n_hours,
            spwh_pres = sum(spwh_pres)/n_hours,
            shr_pres = sum(shr_pres)/n_hours,
            tidal_mag_m = max(height_m, na.rm = TRUE) - min(height_m, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_water_temp_C = mean(water_temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_wind_m_sec = mean(wind_m_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_wind_km_h = mean(wind_km_h, na.rm = TRUE),
            rain_month_avg_mm = mean(rain_month_avg_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
            wind_am_month_avg_kmh = mean(wind_am_month_avg_kmh, na.rm = TRUE),
            wind_pm_month_avg_kmh = mean(wind_pm_month_avg_kmh, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
  filter(n_days >= 0.5*days_in_month(month_UTC)) # only keep months with 15+ days

```
